wizard.welcomeBody: Turn speech into text on your own computer. Your audio stays here: there is no account, and nothing is uploaded.
wizard.summary: Your computer has {{ram}} of memory and a {{cpu}}.
wizard.modelBody: {{name}} is a good match for this computer.
wizard.noRecommendation: No model is an easy fit for this computer, so choose one yourself.
wizard.scanFailed: We could not read your machine's details. You can still continue.

home.tagline: Run speech AI models locally, on your own machine.
home.noJobs: Your finished transcripts will appear here.

add.drop: Drop audio or video files here
add.needModel: Download a model first, then add your files.
add.estimate: Estimated time for these files: about {{time}}.
add.estimateUnknown: The time estimate appears once the length of each file is known.

transcript.empty: This job has no text yet.
transcript.noAudio: The audio file cannot be played. It may have moved.

settings.title: Settings
settings.restart: Models moved. Restart the app to use the new folder.
settings.batteryFloor: Pause the queue on battery below this percent (0 turns this off)
settings.offline: Offline mode: never use the network
settings.privacyBody: SynthSpeech has no telemetry. Audio and transcripts never leave this computer.
settings.retention: Delete finished jobs after this many days (0 keeps them forever)
settings.license: SynthSpeech is free and open source under the MIT license. Third party licenses are listed with each release.
settings.crashHelp: If the app misbehaves, use Copy diagnostics on the Machine screen and include it in a GitHub issue. It contains no audio and no transcripts.
